headers.title: Generate pseudonym
headers.stepone: Search for the entity that you want to pseudonymize.
headers.steptwo: Select the entity that you want to pseudonymize.
headers.stepthree: In which group should the pseudonym be saved?

infotext: If you create a pseudonym for a subgroup, the system will automatically generate a chain of pseudonyms for each parent group.

standalone.description: You can also generate a pseudonym that is not linked to an existing entity. TrustDeck will create an internal standalone identifier for this pseudonym.
standalone.selected: Standalone pseudonym mode is active. Select the group in which the pseudonym should be saved.

selectedEntity.title: Selected entity identifier
selectedEntity.trustDeckIdHint: Entity-based pseudonyms use the entity TrustDeckID with identifier type TrustDeckID, so the pseudonym can be listed as a link of the entity instance later.
